newsitem.title: CHINA: Beiren 1996 profits hit 100 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Beiren 1996 profits hit 100 mln yuan.

text.p: Beiren Printing Machinery Holdings Ltd made about 100 million yuan in profits in 1996, the Beijing Economic Daily said on Thursday.
The report did not say whether the figures were pre-tax, but companies in China normally report pre-tax figures. The newspaper did not give comparative figures.
Beiren became China's largest producer of printing machines in 1996 with a market share of 68 percent, the newspaper said.
The company invested 10 million yuan to boost the reliablity of its products and another 30 million yuan to develop hi-tech printing technology, it said.
